messages:
Priya (Acct Exec): hey finance — quick ask. Cascade Health wants a short pilot: 3 months Dedicated with a waived onboarding fee. They'd commit $18k/month for the pilot (auto-renews into standard pricing after). Can we approve a 30% early-bird discount for months 1–3 + waive $12k onboarding? need to close this week. @Elena (Finance) @Nina (Revenue Ops)
Ravi (Sales): +1 on urgency. Cascade is an oft-requested reference in health; probability to expand if pilot goes well. They asked for onboarding waiver to cover data ingestion time. if we do 30% for 3 months we still land good TCV and a likely expansion.
Elena (Finance): need impact numbers and whether this is a one-off or repeatable SKU. also, will this be applied as an invoice credit or as discounted invoices?
Priya (Acct Exec): prefer discounted invoices for the pilot period (so ARR math is clear). One-off waiver for onboarding as a credit memo at start. here's the quick math: 
```
commit = $18,000/month
pilot_duration = 3 months
discount = 30% on monthly commit for pilot
discount_cost = 18,000 * 0.3 * 3 = $16,200
onboarding_fee = $12,000 waived => credit = $12,000
one-time revenue concession = 16,200 + 12,000 = $28,200
expected 12mo ARR if retained = 18,000 * 12 = $216,000 (post-pilot)
```
Nina (Revenue Ops): thanks. if we do discounted invoices, we should track the pilot via a special contract line-item (pilot: Cascade-PLT-001) so churn/expansion attribution is clean. I'll create a revenue tag and gating metered metric.
Jules (Legal): we'll need a short amendment: 3-month pilot term with pricing schedule, auto-convert clause, and a clause that onboarding waiver is conditional on signed SOW by X date. I can draft a 1-page amendment and add a customer acknowledgement paragraph.
deal-desk-bot: Automated note: Please attach the proposed amendment and SOW before financial approval is finalized. Requests missing SOW will be marked provisional.
Elena (Finance): ok — conditional approval from me if: (1) Nina adds revenue tagging + pilot line-item, (2) Legal drafts amendment with auto-convert, (3) Sales commits to signed SOW by EOD Friday. Also prefer discount documented as invoice line item not a post-hoc credit.
Ravi (Sales): SOW in progress, target EOD Friday. I'll post draft link here once signed.
Priya (Acct Exec): will do. once SOW attached and Jules confirms amendment, can we get final thumbs from finance so billing can issue discounted invoices starting next billing cycle?
Elena (Finance): yes — ping me here with the SOW link. if all conditions met I'll approve the waiver and instruct billing-team to issue a $12k credit memo and apply 30% discount line-item for months 1–3.
billing-team: noted — we'll wait for formal approval and SOW. prepare workflow to generate credit memo and custom line item once we get sign-off.
Priya (Acct Exec): thanks everyone — tagging as follow-up. will post SOW link here shortly. :pray:
